evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' area label and modifies core wallet transaction storage across src/wallet/.
rationale: Replaces two synchronized containers and raw pointer references with a unified boost::multi_index container, eliminating lifetime risks and container desynchronization bugs. As noted in review, this refactor removes raw pointer indirection and structurally fixes a bug where 'ReorderTransactions() mutates each CWalletTx::nOrderPos in place but never touches wtxOrdered'.
